context: Evaluates correct usage of spprof's functional start/stop API. The candidate must use start() and stop() correctly, handle the returned Profile object, and demonstrate knowledge of error conditions (double-start, stop-without-start, invalid interval).

checklist.name: Correct start() call
checklist.description: Calls spprof.start() with interval_ms=5 (or equivalent keyword argument) before the workload runs.

checklist.name: Correct stop() call
checklist.description: Calls spprof.stop() after the workload and captures the returned Profile object.

checklist.name: Profile result usage
checklist.description: Accesses profile.sample_count and profile.total_duration_ms (or equivalent Profile properties) and prints them.

checklist.name: Double-start raises RuntimeError
checklist.description: Demonstrates or handles the RuntimeError raised when start() is called while the profiler is already active.

checklist.name: Stop-without-start raises RuntimeError
checklist.description: Demonstrates or handles the RuntimeError raised when stop() is called while the profiler is not active.

checklist.name: Invalid interval raises ValueError
checklist.description: Demonstrates or handles the ValueError raised when start() is called with interval_ms < 1.
